newsitem.title: USA: LaBarge begins production of Laser Lancet.
newsitem.headline: LaBarge begins production of Laser Lancet.

text.p: LaBarge Inc, which received regulatory approval to market a medical laser, said Tuesday it has begun initial production of the device and will increase production as needed to meet market demand.
In mid-April, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted LaBarge clearance to manufacture and market Laser Lancet, a portable device for drawing blood without the use of needles.
Venisect Inc will market and distribute the device which will be made by LaBarge in Tulsa, Okla.

Earlier today, LaBarge reported earnings for its fiscal third quarter ended March 30, 1997 rose 38 percent from the same period a year ago to $1.7 million or $0.11 a share. Sales for the quarter increased 18 percent to $25.2 million.
LaBarge said results were in line with the company's expectations.
